params.added: - `gh.api` error messages and `Did you mean` suggestions name the methods you probably meant (#382): a misplaced options object, such as `gh.api(endpoint, { method })`, gets an error that shows `gh api` flag examples and says process options go third. `Did you mean` and the `gh has:` list put methods whose names start with the missing name first, so `gh.pr` suggests `prCreate`, `prList`, `prMerge`, and `prView`.
params.changed: - Repository maintainer functions (#381): `tests.runTargeted`, `tests.probeMutation`, and `delivery.format` run `npx --no-install`. `delivery.commit({ push: true })` refuses `main`/`master` before staging anything (`allowDefaultBranch: true` overrides) and retries a `[remote rejected] … (failed)` push once. The waits cap `timeoutMs` at 285000 instead of rejecting larger values.
params.fixed: - `gh.api` uses the program-data budget by default (4 MB, 1,000,000 lines) instead of 50 KB, so large responses are no longer cut mid-JSON (#382). A caller's `maxBytes`/`maxLines` still win.
